<color=#CB0000>LarpZilla Mod:</color>

<color=black>•</color> Cherrizilla's damage cap starts at 1/3 of his maximum Toughness. For every 10 Devour stacks Cherrizilla gains (every 2%), Cherrizilla's damage cap is reduced to 1/(3 + n/10) of his maximum Toughness.
<color=black>•</color> The result of n/10 is always interpreted as an integer.
<color=black>•</color> The number of <color=#CB0000>Epic Modifiers</color> Cherrizilla has affects the number of Devour stacks he gains when he devours a zombie.
	<color=black>•</color> <color=#CB0000>1 Epic Modifier</color> Gains 5 Devour stacks instead of 1.
	<color=black>•</color><color=#CB0000> 2 Epic Modifiers</color> Gains 10 Devour stacks instead of 1.
<color=black>•</color> Acquiring at least <color=#CB0000>1 Epic Modifier</color> will grant newly planted Cherrizillas 35 Devour stacks.</size>
